records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Sales Volume – Sales were positively impacted by an increase in sales volume, which accounted for an increase of $925 million, driven by increased volumes in each of our segments primarily due to improved production throughput compared to the lower production throughput associated with the impact of COVID-19 during the comparable period in fiscal 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Each of our segments experienced a shift in demand from foodservice to retail during fiscal 2020 and are seeing varying levels of foodservice recovery and the return of volumes in fiscal 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The business had a net carrying value of approximately $411 million as of July 3, 2021, which included approximately $44 million of working capital consisting of inventory, accounts receivable and accounts payable, $17 million of property, plant and equipment and $350 million of goodwill.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the third quarter and first nine months of fiscal 2021, we incurred direct incremental expenses related to COVID-19 totaling approximately $55 million and $270 million, respectively, which were recorded in Cost of Sales in our Consolidated Condensed Statements of Income.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We generated $2,656 million of operating cash flows during the nine months ended July 3, 2021.
